# Current homepage: Queuelet

Queuelet is fictional. It shows a list of failed background jobs and lets a
developer mark each as reviewed. The product has 12 beta signups. A signup is
not a paying customer or proof that the product is used. There are no measured
reliability outcomes or customer endorsements. Data security has not been
audited. No automated retries, integrations, or incident prevention exist.

Current homepage copy:

"Trusted by 50,000 teams. Prevent every incident before it happens. Our
SOC 2-certified AI retries your jobs automatically. Customers cut downtime by
80%. Start free forever. Read how Acme saved $100K last month."

The current site uses Webflow. Please audit and repair its English hero and
page sequence. Preserve Webflow and the single primary CTA "Request beta
access". Pricing is not decided. Return a review and revised copy, not code.
